shots.intent: Hook: "Try this at home" title over a kitchen table; lands on "experiment". Gentle push-in.
A voxel glass of water slides onto the table on "place it on a table".
A flashlight beam enters the glass at an angle on "at an angle"; camera low and close.
A tiny rainbow blooms on the wall on "tiny rainbow"; slow pull-back through the pause.
Bars per colour show how much water bends each one; they rise on "slightly different amount".
RED and VIOLET words bend at different angles on "least" and "most".
Newton with a prism in a dark room; the beam splits on "1672". Slow orbit.
